name: hosted
description: Commands and helpers that only work on a server 5dive built, because they talk to 5dive's own servers as that server: `5dive partner hire` (a partner client's agent hires a colleague from the partner's catalogue), the owner's first job at hire (`5dive agent first-job`), the pre-sale handover to the first hire (`5dive handover`), and the native-push helper agents' hooks call when they fail. 5dive's install adds it on every server 5dive built; a self-hosted server has no use for it.

verbs.name: partner
verbs.summary: on a partner's server: hire a colleague from the partner's catalogue

verbs.name: first-job
verbs.summary: on a 5dive-built server: run the owner's first job at hire (core's `agent first-job` forwards here)

verbs.name: handover
verbs.summary: on a 5dive-built server: give what the owner told 5dive before buying to their first hire, once (core's heartbeat runs `handover _tick`)
